execution_gate: A new explicit numeric allocation is required before any provider call.
limitations: The suffix estimate is intentionally loose because checkpoint remaining budgets do not exist until the six source seasons and independent labels are frozen.
No superiority, noninferiority, or expected-effect assumption enters the estimate.
Unknown usage and interrupted requests remain charged at their reservation.
method: Full-season maxima are deliberately used as upper bounds for every suffix. Source and suffix stages add 25% retry headroom; live policies use 2x for verifier and retry traffic.
